members.name: Gravurso
members.title: Lorde do Último Apoio
members.lore: Sustenta passagens que estão cedendo até que o último companheiro atravesse. Só vence quando consegue soltar o peso sem esmagar aquilo que protege.
members.spec: A massive BEAR-like living-kite LORD, BIPED but very nonhuman: short thick neck, deep barrel torso, huge low shoulders, TWO long pendulous arms with enormous wide shovel-like claw hands, TWO short bowed legs and broad THREE-toed bear feet. Head squat SMALL relative to enormous forearms, short square DARK SLATE/ivory muzzle, heavy cheek paper tufts, tiny icy BLUE eyes and two short rounded folded earcorners, no helmet/horns. BODY dominant warm IVORY paper, broad slate throat and underside shadow, ARMOR only dull BRONZE block manacles at BOTH wrists and a broad open structural neck/shoulder YOKE, visible chest/upperarms/thighs; no chest cuirass. Two wide dark UMBER paper sails hang behind shoulders like folded lifting straps, not cape wings. Signature: forearm braces have TWO broad open load-bearing bamboo hooks each, attached at a single real knot hinge, allow palms to brace/fold a surface; all 2 arms visible and empty claws open as though catching falling weight. Grounded forward crouch, shoulders above hands not a bodybuilder human. ONE thick umber braided soul-rabiola rooted rump, terminal a single bronze/ivory folded square load tag. Quiet abdomen with ONE broad central tension fold, NOT muscular abs, no runes. More power in silhouette and hands than equipment.
members.prompt: Create ONE NEW ORIGINAL adult SOULMONSTER LORD CREATURE, not an ordinary human knight with animal head, not an animal simply dressed in armor. Our attached OWN griffin is only a guide to clean 2D manga finish and broad living-paper anatomy; never copy its species, blue palette, diamond crystal, silhouette or wings. Living body is broad taut colored PAPER membrane masses with 2-3 meaningful compression folds and a FEW directional folded-paper tufts at cheek/neck/joints; not realistic flesh/fur/scales/muscle fibers, not a solid origami toy with triangular tessellation. Paper supports/ribs/knots appear ONLY where they carry load and don't outline every surface. Strong adult proportion: head smaller than major body masses, hands/feet/neck designed for action, root anatomy coherent. Considerable visible creature torso and limbs between protective pieces, not full suit of armor. Armor LOCALIZED in 2-3 regions with broad quiet surfaces, thickness and clear joints. Few large details, medium construction, small restrained signature. COLOR by material: dominant BODY neutral or one colored paper mass, ONE ARMOR color in continuous fields, ONE CAPE/SAIL contrast if needed, ONE tiny energy/eye accent. No multicolor borders/inlays in every plate, rainbow bands, ornate filigree, repeated gold trim or face relief on every plate. One base + one hard shadow + restrained hard highlight per material, matte, no gradients/gloss/PBR/noise. members.name: Avelince
members.title: Lorde da Contracorrente
members.lore: Atravessa investidas com um desvio mínimo e devolve a força para o chão. Suas velas só funcionam quando o corpo aceita girar junto.
members.spec: LARGE QUADRUPED LYNX-like beast LORD, FOUR long sprung legs with FOUR wide taloned feline feet, high shoulder hips low stalking turn, deep chest and long flexible spine. Small exposed mature feline paper HEAD with SHORT wide snout, heavy angular muzzle not dragonbeak, small VIOLET eyes, TWO long triangular ear TUFT-SAILS built on curved bamboo ribs not horns. BODY dominant warm LIGHT GRAY taut paper with only a few dark-gray cheek/ankle tufts. ARMOR dark PLUM limited to near shoulder guard and TWO front shin rings, no full torso armor or rear greaves. Signature TWO large sweeping offwhite/plum kite membranes anchored from shoulder rib to flanks as ONE paired flexible steering mantle, one furling upward and one opening downward during lateral pivot; not bat wings or flat decorative cape. Rooted ribs meet shoulder joints clearly; face, FOUR feet and belly exposed. Tail anatomical short bobtail incorporated into ONE slim plum braided soul-rabiola ending forked pale gray flag. Small violet eye/hinge accent only, no gold borders/runes/halo. Dynamic low turning stance with near forepaw braced and opposite rear leg extended, count four roots.

members.name: Torvargo
members.title: Lorde do Primeiro Impacto
members.lore: Abre um caminho pela barreira, mas precisa reconhecer o que há atrás dela antes de avançar. A marca de um golpe certo é a passagem que permanece de pé.
members.spec: BIPED boar-RHINO hybrid BEAST lord with huge deep forward-leaning torso and humped shoulder ridge, small low short square BOAR skull with flat angular DARK nose, small MINT eyes, TWO short thick ivory folded tusks curving SIDEWAYS not up into eyes, thick slate cheek paper tufts. TWO powerful LOW arms ending THREE large clawed digits plus thumb and TWO compact weighty legs with split hooved-claw feet. BODY dominant CHARCOAL taut paper, broad quiet ivory belly/throat tension membrane. ARMOR color dull CORAL RED, localized on ONE huge asymmetric near shoulder IMPACT SHELL and BOTH squat forearm bracers; chest/upperarms/thighs visible and not muscular human abs. TWO narrow dark-red rear paper pennant plates stabilize rump, no broad cape. ONE charcoal braided rabiola rooted rear pelvis with single coral blunt-chevron flag. Feet wide in ready-to-charge pose, not cartoon pig, no helmet or giant hammer. Coral only armor fields, no colored trims.

members.name: Najarcal
members.title: Lorde do Círculo Aberto
members.lore: Prende a ameaça num círculo que sempre conserva uma saída. Se fechar a última abertura, aprisiona também quem veio salvar.
members.spec: SERPENT LORD with TWO long articulated NONHUMAN arms and NO legs, ONE very thick grounded S-coil tail supporting high powerful upper trunk, no human waist or abs. Small mature COBRA paper head, broad LOW upper skull, long shallow flattened snout, THREE short ivory teeth, small deep BLUE eyes under paper brow, no human smile, crown or animal helmet. members.name: Raptório
members.title: Lorde do Instante Partido
members.lore: Interrompe um golpe antes que ele alcance outro parceiro. Precisa recolher as próprias garras a tempo para não transformar defesa em perseguição.
members.spec: BIPED RAPTOR bird BEAST LORD, TWO enormous long WING-FOREARMS with articulated hooked claw hands at wrist and broad folded feather-paper vanes behind arm; these are ONE pair of arms, NOT extra back wings. TWO long reverse-jointed powerful bird legs with huge THREE TALON feet, deeply keeled exposed chest with broad offwhite taut paper planes and a few directional neck ruff folds. Head SMALL sharp adult hawk skull with compact curved graphite beak, small MINT eyes, TWO swept broad triangular crest folds ivory, no helmet, human lips or owl-round face. BODY dominant OFFWHITE/stone gray paper, ARMOR dark NAVY localized to wrist knuckle guards and one broad segmented knee brace on each leg; chest and upperarms visible, no full suit. Signature wrist gauntlets carry TWO blunt outward curved catching prongs like parallel kite ribs, coherent with claws, medium feather vanes angle backward when hands spread to intercept. Slight threequarter swoop landing with one foot bracing and other lifted but both roots clear, no spear/sword. ONE navy braided soul-rabiola rooted at anatomical tail tip, three ivory feather-pennants. Navy armor plain no gold edging, few calm planar shapes not fluttering paper shards.

members.name: Cervoráculo
members.title: Lorde da Rota Restante
members.lore: Encontra a rota que ainda pode sustentar a travessia. Cada direção que aponta exige que ele abandone outra, em vez de prometer todos os caminhos.
members.spec: QUADRUPED STAG BEAST LORD, FOUR long sturdy legs FOUR split hooves, short strong back and deep proud chest, NO human arms.
